# Lumina

> Lumina is an AI meeting assistant for teams. It joins Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft
> Teams calls, transcribes them, and turns the conversation into a summary with decisions
> and action items. Free for teams up to 5 people.

Lumina was formerly named InboxZap, an inbox-cleanup tool. InboxZap is no longer developed;
see /blog/inboxzap-is-now-lumina for what changed.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://lumina.example/): product overview and how it works
- [Features](https://lumina.example/features): full feature list
- [Pricing](https://lumina.example/pricing): plans, including the free tier for teams up to 5
- [FAQ](https://lumina.example/faq): pricing, consent, supported call tools, and the InboxZap-to-Lumina transition
